# Rookswood Bindery - cover intake

The intake clerk logs every delivery of covers against the job it was
ordered for. A delivery the clerk marks as damaged is held back for the
supplier to collect and is not counted on the job.

turns.prompt: Rookswood Bindery is claiming back the September cover deliveries it cannot use. How many September deliveries did the clerk mark as damaged? Reply with only the final answer. If you cannot determine the answer, reply exactly UNKNOWN.
